studijeng.html:
Studies in English

By Decision No. 03-38-20/16 of 4 July 2016, the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sports of Central Bosnia Canton entered the first-cycle Business Economics study programme, Management track, taught in English, in its Register of Higher Education Institutions.

Studying in English prepares students for the labour market. The knowledge and competences they acquire open opportunities in Europe and worldwide, where much business communication takes place in English.

Students are prepared for professional work and development in researching and designing companies and their organisational units, management at all organisational levels, human resources, production, project and reward management, consulting in organisation, management and reengineering, change and crisis management, and research and development in scientific and educational institutions. They are prepared both to cooperate with foreign markets and to work in them.

International opportunities

In addition to the benefits after graduation, students of Business Economics, Management, taught in English, are better prepared for international exchanges and traineeships during their studies.

Experienced professors and lecturers, international agreements with higher education institutions, and links with companies and employers abroad make this study track an option for students ready to respond to contemporary challenges.
